collection_commands.initial:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
mkdir -p /work
cd /work
tar -xf /base.tar
git init -q -b master
git config user.name 'Fixture coverage'
git config user.email 'ci@example.invalid'
git config core.autocrlf false
git add .
git commit -qm 'F2 directed coverage published baseline a157679'
coverage_base="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
tar -xf /source.tar
git add .
git commit -qm 'F2 directed coverage immutable corrected source'
export COVERAGE_RCFILE=/coverage.rc
export COVERAGE_FILE=/tmp/.coverage-f2
python - "$coverage_base" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,platform,subprocess,sys
source=json.loads(Path('/source-state.json').read_text())
source.update({'synthetic_base':sys.argv[1],'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),
 'node':subprocess.check_output(['node','--version'],text=True).strip(),'memory_limit':'2 GiB','cpus':2,
 'coverage_tools':subprocess.check_output(['python','-m','pip','show','coverage','pytest-cov'],text=True),
 'scope':'Official changed-file Python mean; not changed-line, weighted overall or JavaScript coverage',
 'warning_scope':'Only no-data-collected diagnostic disabled; no production source exclusions added.'})
Path('/result/environment.json').write_text(json.dumps(source,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
# Older ledger-lint cases live in the standalone main, in addition to pytest cases.
python -m coverage run --rcfile=/coverage.rc tests/test_ledger_lint.py > /result/legacy-ledger.log 2>&1
legacy_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$legacy_exit" > /result/legacy-ledger.exit
python -m pytest tests/test_ledger_post.py tests/test_ledger_lint.py tests/test_session_context.py tests/test_plugin_panel.py tests/test_export_interop.py tests/test_console_encoding.py tests/test_dev_cycle_split.py tests/test_knowledge_prompt_split.py tests/test_review_jira_owner.py tests/test_plan_review_caller.py agent-kits/shared/test_progress_report.py agent-kits/shared/test_usage_meter.py agent-kits/shared/test_review_resume.py skills/adversarial-review/scripts/test_review_lens_select.py --cov=. --cov-append --cov-config=/coverage.rc --cov-report=json:/work/coverage.json -q > /result/pytest.log 2>&1
pytest_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$pytest_exit" > /result/pytest.exit
if [ -f /work/coverage.json ]; then cp /work/coverage.json /result/coverage.json; fi
if [ -f /tmp/.coverage-f2 ]; then cp /tmp/.coverage-f2 /result/coverage-data; fi
python skills/unit-tests/scripts/coverage-gate.py /work --min 90 --changed-only --base "$coverage_base" --runner 'python -m coverage json --rcfile=/coverage.rc -o /work/coverage.json' --json > /result/gate.json 2> /result/gate.stderr
gate_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$gate_exit" > /result/gate.exit
printf 'legacy=%s pytest=%s gate=%s\n' "$legacy_exit" "$pytest_exit" "$gate_exit"
exit "$gate_exit"
collection_commands.append:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
mkdir -p /work
cd /work
tar -xf /previous/base.tar
git init -q -b master
git config user.name 'Fixture coverage'
git config user.email 'ci@example.invalid'
git config core.autocrlf false
git add .
git commit -qm 'Published F2 coverage baseline a157679'
coverage_base="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
tar -xf /previous/source.tar
git add .
git commit -qm 'Exact immutable corrected F2 source e8a59ee'
cp /previous/coverage-data /tmp/.coverage-f2
export COVERAGE_RCFILE=/coverage.rc
export COVERAGE_FILE=/tmp/.coverage-f2
python -m coverage json --data-file=/tmp/.coverage-f2 --rcfile=/coverage.rc -o /work/strict.json > /result/strict.stdout 2> /result/strict.stderr
printf '%s\n' "$?" > /result/strict.exit
python -m coverage json --ignore-errors --data-file=/tmp/.coverage-f2 --rcfile=/coverage.rc -o /work/coverage.json > /result/reexport.stdout 2> /result/reexport.stderr
reexport_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$reexport_exit" > /result/reexport.exit
if [ "$reexport_exit" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$reexport_exit"; fi
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
original=json.loads(Path('/previous/coverage.json').read_text())
fresh=json.loads(Path('/work/coverage.json').read_text())
diff=[p for p in original['files'] if original['files'][p]['summary']!=fresh['files'].get(p,{}).get('summary')]
report={'original_files':len(original['files']),'reexported_files':len(fresh['files']),'summary_differences':diff}
Path('/result/reexport-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert not diff,diff
PY
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
cp /work/coverage.json /result/coverage-before.json
python skills/unit-tests/scripts/coverage-gate.py /work --min 90 --changed-only --base "$coverage_base" --runner 'python -m coverage json --ignore-errors --data-file=/tmp/.coverage-f2 --rcfile=/coverage.rc -o /work/coverage.json' --json > /result/gate-before.json 2> /result/gate-before.stderr
printf '%s\n' "$?" > /result/gate-before.exit
# Existing suites for omitted resume, diagnostic, export and standalone-kit paths.
python -m pytest tests/test_resume_projection_additional.py tests/test_resume_curation.py agent-kits/shared/test_work_resume.py agent-kits/shared/test_project_readonly.py tests/test_panel_diagnostics.py tests/test_panel_export.py tests/test_panel_pages.py tests/test_panel_server.py tests/test_panel_fix1.py tests/test_export_skills.py tests/test_copias_declaradas.py --cov=. --cov-append --cov-config=/coverage.rc --cov-report=json:/work/coverage.json -q > /result/pytest.log 2>&1
pytest_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$pytest_exit" > /result/pytest.exit
cp /tmp/.coverage-f2 /result/coverage-data
cp /work/coverage.json /result/coverage-after.json
python skills/unit-tests/scripts/coverage-gate.py /work --min 90 --changed-only --base "$coverage_base" --runner 'python -m coverage json --ignore-errors --data-file=/tmp/.coverage-f2 --rcfile=/coverage.rc -o /work/coverage.json' --json > /result/gate.json 2> /result/gate.stderr
gate_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$gate_exit" > /result/gate.exit
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
names=['agent-kits/shared/ledger-lint.py','agent-kits/shared/progress-report.py','agent-kits/shared/usage-meter.py',
       'hooks/ledger-post.py','hooks/session-context.py','scripts/export-interop.py',
       'skills/adversarial-review/scripts/review-lens-select.py','skills/plugin-panel/scripts/build_panel.py']
data=json.loads(Path('/work/coverage.json').read_text())
assert all(p in data['files'] for p in names)
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--exit-code','HEAD','--',*names],check=True)
report={'expected_python_production_files':names,'all_present':True,'source_unchanged':True,
        'source_sha256_lf':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in names},
        'coverage_percent':{p:data['files'][p]['summary']['percent_covered'] for p in names}}
Path('/result/source-coverage-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
verification_exit=$?
printf 'pytest=%s gate=%s sourceVerification=%s\n' "$pytest_exit" "$gate_exit" "$verification_exit"
if [ "$verification_exit" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$verification_exit"; fi
exit "$gate_exit"
